title: The check-tail guard reads `&` inside expansions and arithmetic correctly
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 16:00 CST Nov 8, from round-3 or later reviews; queued follow-up the lane starts when its wait ends. Waits on #2156. Allowed where main refuses: `echo ${x:-$(npm start & )}` and `i { &`. False alarms: `for((i=0;i&1;i++))`, `while((i&1))`, `echo $[5&3]`. Allowed on base too: `echo a & ci-job x | tail -3 & echo $!` and `ci-job x | tail -3 &&`+newline+`echo done & echo $!`.
note: Folded finding (#1717 round 3, sonnet, via lane bg-tail-loses-verdict 22:30 CST Nov 8): `check_tail_hit` reads no `$( )` or backtick text, so `x=$(merge --lane-lint 7 2>&1 | tail -3)` passes on main and head. Main has `substitution_commands` (hooks/guard_env.py) to reuse. Debt note check-tail-no-nested-read lists only bash -c and `{ }`; extend it. From #2015 (check-tail-any-filter, round 3 passed, net value positive; lane bg-tail-loses-verdict 22:32 CST Nov 8): (1) stale notes in docs/debts/notes.md say `Select-Object -Last` and a trailing `& echo $!` pass; both are now refused, and the decision's Known gaps lists three notes, not five. (2) Rare false alarm in hooks/guard_stream.py: `ci-job checks --lint & echo $! | cat` is refused, since the `&` stays in the stage and `cat` reads as a filter. (3) No named mutant covers the `|&` skip in `_ends_in_ampersand`; the allowed row `ci-job checks --lint |& tail -3` has not been shown red. From #2156 (check-tail-glued-amp, round 3 at 7e81f6038 PASS, reviewer sonnet, net value positive; 22:37 CST Nov 8): (1) hooks/guard_core.py `_bash_arithmetic_spans` is quadratic when a `$((` is never closed and an `&` is present (2000 openers 0.77 s, 8000 openers 12.9 s). (2) `_amp_cuts` reads the legacy `$[1&2]` as a background job, a false refusal. (3) The unquoted-URL remedy moved to step glued-amp-url-remedy. From #2389 round 1 (reviewer haiku, 23:16 CST Nov 8; on main too): `{ verdict x; } | tail` and `(verdict x; true) | tail` are allowed (hooks/guard_stream.py), so the pipe hides verdict's exit code and FAIL line; the verdict-pipe rule reads only a segment whose command word is `verdict`, not a group or subshell piped onward. From stack B's fresh round 3 (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, reviewer sonnet, 00:10 CST Nov 9; all three PRs pass, net value positive): (a) hooks/guard_stream.py:172-180 (#2156): `ci-job x > log 2>&1 & echo $! | cat` is refused, though the check never feeds the pipe; rare, same class as the `echo $! | cat` note above. (b) hooks/guard_stream.py ~171 (#2015 alone): a foreground `ci-job checks --lint | grep "&"` is refused; #2156 fixes it, so #2015 merges with #2156. (c) The hooks/guard_kill.py:589-594 docstring still says "`&` as its own token", and hooks/mutate_guard.py:536 still cites "zero harmless matches in 16571", which measured the old spaced-`&` reader. (d) hooks/mutate_guard.py:3703 (#2156): the MUTATE_ONLY filter sits outside the glued-`&` scope; it fails closed, and CI does not set the variable. (e) No mutant pins the `amp_pieces` use at hooks/guard.py:4015; a test row pins it. From #2156's fresh round 3 (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, reviewer sonnet, 02:23 CST Nov 9, head ff50b3f10, PASS, net value positive; none blocks): (f) hooks/guard_stream.py:183-195,227: `ci-job x | tail -3 && (echo z & echo $!)` is refused, because the list reader counts a `&` that backgrounds only the group as ending the list; main allowed it; contrived. (g) docs/decisions/background-check-through-verdict.md does not state the `&&`/`||` list case (`ci-job x | tail && echo done & echo $!` is refused); only the code docstring holds it. (h) hooks/mutate_guard.py:3703-3708: the new MUTATE_ONLY=<label> switch has no test; an exported MUTATE_ONLY that names a test selector now exits 1 where it was ignored; a normal run is unchanged. Adds to (d). Notes (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, from #1717's fresh round 3, PASS at 907ae9291, 05:14 CST Nov 9): (1) hooks/guard_stream.py `_skip_uv_run` tests `basename(...) == "uv"`, so `uv.exe run merge --lane-lint 7 | tail` passes; the interpreter gate strips `.exe` but this test does not (Windows spelling only, low harm). (2) hooks/mutate_guard.py has no hand-written mutation rows for `check_tail_hit`, `_whole_word` or `UV_VALUE_FLAGS`; only the CI `--changed` report-only run covers them. After #1717 merges, two doc-only notes from its round 3 (reviewer sonnet, 12:20 CST Nov 9, head adf69d382, PASS, net positive; lane bg-tail-loses-verdict): (1) docs/decisions/background-check-through-verdict.md lines 16-17 list the merge spellings as a closed set, but a direct ./merge/merge.py is now refused too, through the .py command-word rule (hooks/guard_stream.py:145-146); (2) line 18 says ci-job applies "as the bullet above says", but the bullet above is the uv run bullet (the ci-job fact is at line 10), and it drops the interpreter_only pointer (guard_stream.py:133).
